description: This file is a Python source file implementing a library for gathering system and test log information during TensorFlow testing. It defines functions for executing tests, processing logs, retrieving system info, and involves interaction with external modules like gfile, subprocess, and proto messages.

classes.name: MissingLogsError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling missing log errors

methods.name: get_git_commit_sha()
methods.description: Retrieves the current git commit SHA from environment variable GIT_COMMIT.

methods.name: process_test_logs(name, test_name, test_args, benchmark_type, start_time, run_time, log_files)
methods.description: Collects and processes test logs to produce a TestResults protobuf message.

methods.name: process_benchmarks(log_files)
methods.description: Merges benchmark entries from log files into a Benchmarks protobuf message.

methods.name: run_and_gather_logs(name, test_name, test_args, benchmark_type, skip_processing_logs=False)
methods.description: Runs a specified test target, collects logs, and returns processed test results along with a benchmark name.

ctags.name: process_test_logs
ctags.signature: (name, test_name, test_args, benchmark_type, start_time, run_time, log_files)
